queer_characters.name: Lili Elbe
queer_characters.notes: Film explicitly depicts Lili's awakening feminine identity and gender-affirming surgery; based on a real historical figure. Rep is mixed because critics noted the script's problematic framing of trans identity and the casting of cisgender actor Eddie Redmayne, who later called it 'a mistake.'

queer_characters.name: Gerda Wegener
queer_characters.notes: Described as one of 'the loves of each other's lives' with Lili; the film centers their enduring bond, but the source text does not assign Gerda a specific sexual-orientation label.
queer_characters.contest_notes: Whether Gerda reads as queer depends on interpretation of her continued devotion to Lili after Lili's transition; the source text emphasizes their love but gives no explicit self-identification.
